arabic_html:
فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ
وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ ۖ
وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًۭا ۞
hook:
The one increase
He told us to ask for.
translation: So high above all is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth. And do not hasten with recitation of the Qur’ān before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
explanation_html: Maʿārif-ul-Qurʾān: the Prophet ﷺ was told not to rush the revelation before it was complete — and in the same breath given the one duʿāʾ for more: increase me in knowledge.
